summary.text: Zhou Li is a rank seven Eastern Sea Gu Immortal present when a group of Eastern Sea immortals confront Fang Yuan over an inheritance imprint.

claims.text: Tang Song of Tang clan names him and asks what he is afraid of, then steps forward himself to press Fang Yuan over a missing inheritance imprint. Fang Yuan had already shown two rank seven Immortal Gu, and the Eastern Sea group no longer treats him as an ordinary rank six. Tang Song is the only rank seven among them with a super force behind him.

When Fang Yuan uses sword escape Immortal Gu and pulls ahead, Zhou Li offers to carry Tang Song and Liu Qing Yu at great speed if they restrain the target. Phantom waves appear around his body, an immortal killer move that lifts all three. With two attackers free to strike, Fang Yuan is injured. Zhou Li judges that Fang Yuan has only two rank seven Immortal Gu and that the rest of his methods are mortal killer moves.

Those phantom waves then engulf Fang Yuan. Zhou Li had collected information on Fang Yuan’s methods, used the other two as cover, and gathered the waves into a huge force before attacking. Liu Qing Yu reads him as weak and timid on the surface, then more shrewd than expected. The move uses almost all of Zhou Li’s Immortal Gu, strong in attack and weak in defense. When Fang Yuan feigns an ambush, Zhou Li withdraws most of the waves, Fang Yuan slips through the gap into the blue water regional wall, and Zhou Li slaps himself before giving chase. He and Tang Song later lose Fang Yuan in the wall and turn on Liu Qing Yu, suspecting the imprint.
Immortal Hua Die later warns that Ding Yan, who once held clues to an information path inheritance, was attacked by Liu Qing Yu, Zhou Li, and Tang Song, and that Ding Yan is dead.

Zhou Li and Tang Song gather Gu Immortals in the turbulent flow sea area after news of Liu Qing Yu’s move and the inheritance clue. They fight Ding Qi, then find Fang Yuan already holding the inheritance. They give up that target, chase Fang Yuan into a bubble, and enter after him. Fang Yuan’s strength path giant hand kills most of the group. Zhou Li and Tang Song are among the last three standing, resist a further strike, and die. Fang Yuan later finds only their corpses complete and stores them in the sovereign immortal aperture.

After absorbing that foundation, Fang Yuan counts around eleven thousand water path dao marks from this lone immortal. A later tally still groups him among Eastern Sea lone immortals killed for water path accumulations.
